thread:
jordan: Quick postmortem follow-up from this morning's outage. We need owners, acceptance criteria, and timelines for all mitigation items. I will own the action tracker.

maya: I can own the region-fallback runbook updates. Known gaps: healthcheck thresholds and model-registry fallback mapping. Plan: update runbook + tabletop drill. ETA 2026-04-08.

liam: I will take model-registry token hardening (rotate TTLs, add refresh metrics) and add an alert for recurring 401s. Staging rollout ETA 2026-04-05.

ana: Thanks @liam. Also need an alert tuned for bursts of 401s so we catch the pattern earlier.

liam: Adding amplitude-based alert and a dedicated 401 monitor, will link pager rule here when done.

ana: I'll own auth-provider fallback verification 1: confirm regen flow and fallback token path work. ETA 2026-04-06.

sam: Infra action: address single-region control-plane dependency and add multi-region failover for control plane + ASG terraform changes. PR ETA 2026-04-12, dry-run 2026-04-19.

jordan: Please add short rows to the shared tracker: owner, artifact (runbook / terraform / alert), acceptance criteria, ETA. I'll chase missing owners by EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: New action created: "orchid-2026-region-fallback-update" assigned to maya, due 2026-04-08.

oncall-bot: Reminder: weekly incident drills Fri 2026-04-09. Sign up: https://calendar.company/internal/drills

maya: Tracker row: owner: maya; artifact: runbook "region-fallback"; acceptance: automated dry-run with simulated provider outage, verified within 5m; ETA: 2026-04-08.

liam: Tracker row: owner: liam; artifact: model-registry token refresh + alerting; acceptance: no unrefreshed tokens in 24h synthetic test; alerts firing for >10 401s/min; ETA: 2026-04-05.

ana: Tracker row: owner: ana; artifact: auth-provider fallback verification; acceptance: regen flow validated and fallback exercised; ETA: 2026-04-06.

sam: Tracker row: owner: sam; artifact: terraform for control-plane ASG + failover playbook; acceptance: controlled dry-run with traffic shift and <2% client error delta; ETA: PR 2026-04-12, dry-run 2026-04-19.

jordan: Cross-owner item: liam + maya sync on registry fallback mapping (which model variants to serve when registry is read-only). Coordinate and store a priority map with registry config.

liam: Example priority_map.yaml I'll PR and test: primary: redwood-model-v2; fallbacks: [redwood-model-v1-quant, llama-lite]. Will add read-only registry test harness.

maya: Adding runbook step to pick first available fallback and validate KV cache TTLs to avoid cold starts.

jordan: Product task: define fallback-quality metrics and rollback thresholds. @ana can you capture metric defs?

ana: Starting doc at docs/incidents/fallback-quality.md. Sketch metrics: similarity metric, latency delta, and error rate thresholds.

sam: Ops ask: need maintenance window approved to run dry-run. Sending proposed windows to Jordan.

jordan: Approved once SRE okays comms. Send windows and I9ll coordinate.

ops-bot: Action update: "model-registry-token-rotation" moved to In Progress (liam).

liam: Running synthetic 401 test locally now, will add to CI. Test command: curl -X POST https://model-registry.internal/test-token -d '{"simulate":"expired_token"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer expired' -> returns 401.

ana: Add CI job name to tracker.

jordan: I9ll consolidate tracker entries and brief execs next week. If any ETA slips, post reason + new ETA here.

maya: Adding quarterly pre-mortem checklist: run failover dry-run every quarter.

sam: Also will notify partner-account team before any dry-run.

jordan: Please update your tracker rows by EOD Friday or I'll assign follow-ups. :eyes: 

liam: Will do.

ana: On it.

maya: Done, tracker rows updated. :white_check_mark:
